snippet.title: PAC-MAN 256 - PS4/X1/PC - 4 times more Pac-Man! (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
PAC-MAN 256 is now available on PS4, Xbox One and STEAM! Escape the glitch and hunt the ghosts in cooperation up to 4 players! The new console version also includes a social sharing feature and 10 unlocked themes! 

Start playing right now: 

PS4: http://bnent.eu/PM256PS4
Xbox One: http://bnent.eu/PM256X1
STEAM: http://bnent.eu/PM256PC

Official Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/pacman
